argument: The chapter is not yet publishable because its card-type definition contradicts its own cards and the glossary. It states that talents are always on and never activated [09-talents-abilities:13][09-talents-abilities:15], yet seven cards typed Talent carry an activation Action: Fortune's Favor is a Reaction [09-talents-abilities:27], Quick Study is Free [09-talents-abilities:187], Rally the Troops is a Maneuver [09-talents-abilities:207]. The glossary repeats the always-on claim and explicitly names Fortune's Favor as an example [21-glossary:85], so the same card is passive in canon and Reaction in this chapter. Separately, no header line in the file carries a Duration field, nor a duration folded into Range, although the chapter's own card template requires one and the spell chapters carry it; every header stops at Disciplines, Action, Range and Keywords [09-talents-abilities:243]. Fourth, the statement that each maneuver is gated by a weapon Discipline [09-talents-abilities:301] is false for Shield Slam, gated on 2 Armor [09-talents-abilities:375] (canon-confirmed [08-disciplines:122]) and Renewal, gated on 1 Protection [09-talents-abilities:529]. Minimal fix: reword the Talent definition so triggered talents are permitted (and align the glossary), add the missing Duration header field to all 42 cards, and correct the gating sentence at [09-talents-abilities:301]. Cross-reference integrity itself is clean: every @sec-* link resolves and no typed period follows one.

evidence.claim: The chapter defines talents as passive and always on, implying no activation step.
Fortune's Favor is typed Talent but its header gives an activation Action, contradicting the passive definition.
The glossary calls talents activation-free and names Fortune's Favor, the same card this chapter types as a Reaction.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Does not require activation. Examples: Tough

evidence.claim: A representative card header lists only four fields, none of them Duration, and this pattern repeats on all 42 cards.
The chapter asserts every weapon maneuver is gated by a weapon Discipline.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Each is gated by weapon Disciplines.

evidence.claim: Shield Slam is typed Weapon Maneuver but gated on 2 Armor, not a weapon Discipline; canon confirms the Armor gate.
The disciplines chapter's prerequisite table lists Shield Slam against 2 Armor, so line 301's blanket weapon-Discipline claim cannot stand.
